/bin/bash -lc "cat >> storage/evaluator_test.go <<'EOF'

func TestStringPresentConstraintCanBeCreatedWithoutValue(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 segment, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name(), Name: t.Name()})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 c, err := segmentStore.CreateConstraint(ctx, &flipt.CreateConstraintRequest{SegmentKey: segment.Key, Type: flipt.ComparisonType_STRING_COMPARISON_TYPE, Property: \"name\", Operator: \"PRESENT\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.Equal(t, \"present\", c.Operator)
 assert.Empty(t, c.Value)
}
EOF
gofmt -w storage/evaluator_test.go
GOPROXY=off go test ./storage -run TestStringPresentConstraintCanBeCreatedWithoutValue -count=1"

 require.NotNil(t, resp.Timestamp)
}
